thesis: The episode introduces Harold Jacobson, an FX volatility trader with 15 years of experience in derivatives, who discusses his background starting in 2007 and his transition from pricing to full-time trading. The conversation highlights the unique characteristics of the FX volatility market, including its focus on hedging cash flow and liquidity, multi-dimensional arbitrage conditions, and the challenges of OTC trading for price discovery.
